entities.summary: Julio Vallejo Ruiloba was a Spanish psychiatrist, medical doctor, Chairman of the Psychiatry Department at the Universitat de Barcelona, ex-President of the Spanish Psychiatry Society, and Academician of the Royal Academy of Medicine of Catalonia. He wrote 56 books about psychiatry and more than 350 scientific papers.
